articles.title: WPG@MTL: What you need to know
Utah Continues Road Trip in Toronto
Updates from optional morning skate – Nov. 3
Mammoth at Maple Leafs projected lineups

away.summary: The Utah Mammoth (10-6-0) head to Montreal for a road matchup against the Canadiens. Coach Andre Tourigny would not confirm his starting goalie, though Sebastian Cossa was in the starter's net at morning skate and has alternated starts with Karel Vejmelka over the past four games. The Mammoth are without Kailer Yamamoto, Maveric Lamoureux, and John Marino due to injuries, while Ben McCartney and Artem Duda are listed as scratched.

returning: detail: missed six games with a left hand injury
detail: missed two games with illness
home.summary: The Montreal Canadiens (9-3-3) welcome the Utah Mammoth to the Bell Centre. Nick Suzuki and Kirby Dach will each return to the lineup, replacing forwards Florian Xhekaj and Owen Beck, who are scratched. Suzuki missed six games after injuring his left hand on Oct. 20 against San Jose, while Dach sat out the past two games due to illness. Jacob Fowler is projected to start in net, with Jakub Dobes as the backup.
